_extract.note: Complete reverse-audit extract for the PagerDuty eight-pack suite. Every official REST method/path operation is admitted; the root preserves all 14 shipped IDs and wire routes.
_extract.unpaged_collection_note: These collection-shaped reads lack a complete documented continuation request/response pair. They remain one-dispatch calls and are never mislabeled single_page.

createEnrichmentSchema.reason: The structured JSON representation exposes the complete schema definition; CSV records remain uploadable through uploadEnrichmentCsv.

uploadEnrichmentCsv.reason: Raw text/csv preserves the complete record-upload capability without inventing multipart boundary or binary-file synthesis in the HTTP adapter.

source_decision.reason: The official incident response does not require a mutable version field, and classic offset pagination is documented only through 10,000 rows. A complete fail-closed Source contract is therefore not proven.
